conflicts_and_limits: Broad green-organization base-write advice is conditional and cannot override least-privilege or the owned function-polyrepo model.
Minimum-two-owner recommendation and enterprise single-account consolidation require explicit applicability for solo and independently governed entities.
Organization-team duplication language must be reconciled with later enterprise-team and EMU synchronization alternatives.
Entra Conditional Access is not universally equivalent to network allowlisting; actual integration addresses and identity coverage require evidence.
Enterprise rulesets' non-bypassable description is not native proof; effective state, targeting, inheritance, bypass permissions and required workflow behavior need independent tests.
Seven-day no-data-loss streaming assertion needs measured delivery/backfill and does not prove durable custody.
Webhook HTTPS/IP allowlisting does not replace signature validation or missing-event reconciliation.
All account features, pricing/defaults, installation limits, license exceptions and retention figures are dated source assertions, not current estate observations.
Read-only text review grants no reorganization, transfer, credential, spending, exposure, licensing clearance or native activation authority.
Diagrams, linked pages and independent omission certification remain unreviewed.
